discription: A basic sawtooth wave passed through a resonant low-pass filter, with the filter cutoff modulated by the amplitude envelope, creating a warm, evolving sound.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=0.01, decay=0.1, sustain=0.8, release=1.0, cutoff=2000, rq=0.5; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = Saw.ar(freq); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff * env + 100, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
